page.layout: One block of text in a single column, top to bottom: running head with page number at the top; the paragraph of text; below it a catchword-like signature "JVSTI" at the lower right. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side in the middle of the page, not transcribed.

main_text.p: tiam, nullius me famæ in-vidisse, quosdam meæ. Quod si ævum hoc parum etiam gratum sit : quid novi? Suum cuique pretium posteritas rependet. Tu Lector vale, & juvantem, aut certè volentem, ama.

page.notes: Running head reads "184 ALLOCVTIO." with the number 184 printed at left. The word "JVSTI" at the foot right is likely a signature or catchword-like mark; it is recorded under signature. Show-through from the reverse page appears in the lower half and is omitted. The first line "tiam" is a fragment continuing from the previous page; the last words are printed in italic with the roman "Suum cuique pretium posteritas rependet." Possible printed error: "invidisse" is read as printed "invidisse" with long s rendered as s.
